name: Country Antique Fair Mall
tagline: Charming multi-dealer emporium of vintage jewelry, rustic primitives, and retro decor
description: A delight for vintage hunters on North Glassell. Featuring dozens of dealer spaces packed with antique estate jewelry, Victorian silver, retro kitchenware, vintage clocks, and primitives from California homesteads.
historicNote: Located in a vintage 1918 commercial brick building with classic storefront display windows that frequently appeared in Hollywood productions.

specials.title: Estate Jewelry Showcase 10% Off
specials.description: 10% discount on all vintage silver rings, brooches, and antique lockets at participating display cases.
